claims.text: Sunlight looks white, but it contains all the colors of the rainbow combined.

claims.fix: Remove arbitrary chart values or use a spectrum representation, as sunlight contains a continuous spectrum where blue is actually more intense in photon number per wavelength than red.

claims.text: Air molecules scatter short blue wavelengths much more than other colors.
Human cone cell sensitivity peaks in the green-blue region, and solar violet emission is lower, making violet less perceived.

claims.fix: Rayleigh scattering intensity is inversely proportional to the fourth power of wavelength. Violet (approx 400 nm) is scattered roughly 5.5 to 6 times more than red (approx 700 nm), and about 9.5 times more than red if comparing extreme ends, but compared to green/yellow the factor is lower. Change to '5x' or remove exact multiplier.

fixedIssues.fix: Human cone cell sensitivity peaks in the green-blue region, and solar violet emission is also lower, making violet less perceived, though not strictly a simple 2x multiplier.
